dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Fungal orbital cellulitis (mucormycosis/zygomycosis) complicating invasive fungal sinusitis in a patient with newly diagnosed diabetic ketoacidosis-prone hyperglycaemia.

1. Bacterial orbital cellulitis secondary to sinusitis (less likely given normal inflammatory markers and orbital apical involvement)
2. Invasive sinus infection by non-fungal organism (e.g., tuberculosis or nocardiosis)
3. Non-infectious orbital inflammatory disease (idiopathic orbital inflammation/pseudotumour) or granulomatosis with polyangiitis (less likely given absence of systemic features and normal ANCA not yet performed)
